title: Prime sieve
summary: Sieve of Eratosthenes up to ten million.
description: Marks the composites up to 10,000,000 in a byte array with the classic sieve (inner loop starts at p*p), then prints the number of primes, the largest prime and the sum of all primes.
reveals: Strided memory writes over a ten-megabyte array: cache and memory bandwidth plus loop overhead.
caveat: Python and Ruby use their fastest idiom for large byte arrays where one exists (slice assignment in Python; a byte string with setbyte in Ruby and PHP). Other languages use a plain byte or boolean array.
